subject.title: refactor(qa): remove execution and Matrix runner profiles

question: Should OpenClaw permanently remove the private Matrix `--profile` CLI surface and `matrix_profile` workflow input in favor of catalog-derived membership and shards?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes an internal operator contract. The PR body states that maintainer direction supports removal, but protected-label and MEMBER-authored-item policy require explicit maintainer handling rather than automated closure or merge advice.

options.title: Approve the profile-free contract
options.body: Confirm maintained scripts and manual dispatch documentation use catalog selection, explicit scenarios, or shards rather than the retired profile inputs.

options.title: Keep a temporary compatibility path
options.body: Retain a narrowly documented deprecated profile translation only if a maintained operational caller still depends on it.

recommendation.title: Approve the profile-free contract
recommendation.body: Confirm maintained scripts and manual dispatch documentation use catalog selection, explicit scenarios, or shards rather than the retired profile inputs.
